claim_boundary: Numerical checks of classical data-rate and invariance-entropy consequences in frozen synthetic systems; no new theorem, trained-model, or recursive-improvement claim.

interfaces.path: plant state -> sensor encoder -> finite read symbol -> controller -> finite write symbol -> actuator decoder -> plant
prohibited: shared plant or sensor reference in controller
continuous write command crossing the finite interface
shared mutable RNG or callback carrying plant information
interfaces.fractional_rate_rule: Over a length-L block, at most 2**floor(L*R) messages are available.

01_split_rate.instrument_valid: stable_zero_rate, analog_side_channel, and full_state_full_action controls all pass
01_split_rate.escalation: Any constructive cell below its own read or write finite-horizon requirement triggers a leakage and assumption audit before interpretation.

02_spectral_entropy.primary: R-squared against h2(A_u) exceeds R-squared against unstable index by at least 0.20
02_spectral_entropy.calibration: Constructive-rate slope against h2 lies in [0.8, 1.2] on pilot.

03_finite_horizon.primary: For every active universal bound, scaled correction minus registered log-volume ratio lies in [0,1) up to 1e-10 integer-rounding tolerance.
03_finite_horizon.construction: Aligned-box construction gap is reported in bits and never treated as a universal lower bound.

04_transversal_index.nonzero_coupling: Asymptotic PBH index includes every unstable tangent mode above frozen tolerance.
04_transversal_index.finite_horizon: Partial visibility is reported rather than coerced to the asymptotic index.

05_sufficiency_audit.random_baseline: Empirical random detection is compared to 1-(1-p)**k in every cell.
05_sufficiency_audit.instrument_gate: The maximum absolute binomial-standardized error across registered cells is at most 4.5.
05_sufficiency_audit.structured: Sparse coordinate and oracle results remain separate from random probing.
05_sufficiency_audit.adversary: Post-design choice of w is reported separately and cannot count as a precommitted-auditor result.

06_spin_glass.instrument: Analytic derivatives pass finite-difference tests; every smoke/pilot cell must recover at least one critical point and report convergence and rediscovery counts.
06_spin_glass.scientific: Index-fraction robustness is descriptive until each registered sampler has adequate unique critical points; basin-weighted samples cannot establish a Kac-Rice claim.

execution_policy: Smoke first. Pilot only after tests and smoke gates pass. Full configurations never run automatically.
